_readme: Template for the EPAM Image Composer schema.
The exact import shape differs between Content Hub versions.
Before importing, export one existing entity definition from your instance (Manage > Schema) and match this file to that shape.
Names, types and relations below are the part that matters. The wrapper structure is the part to adjust.

propertyAdditions.name: assetVariant
propertyAdditions.label: Asset variant
propertyAdditions.help: Set by the image adapter (cutout) and the composer (composed).

propertyAdditions.name: compositionLayout
propertyAdditions.label: Composition layout
propertyAdditions.help: JSON written by the composer. Do not edit by hand.

entityDefinitions.name: EPAM.ComposerBackground
entityDefinitions.label: Composer background
entityDefinitions.notes: isActive defaults to true. Admins switch a background off instead of deleting it, so old compositions keep their relation.

relationDefinitions.name: EPAMComposerBackgroundToAsset
relationDefinitions.label: Background image
relationDefinitions.notes: One asset can back many composer backgrounds. Each composer background has one asset. Confirm which side is parent and child against how Content Hub exports an existing relation.

relationDefinitions.name: EPAMCutoutToSourceAsset
relationDefinitions.label: Source asset
relationDefinitions.notes: Parent is the original headshot. Child is the cutout.

relationDefinitions.name: EPAMComposedAssetToCutout
relationDefinitions.label: Cutout used
relationDefinitions.notes: Parent is the cutout. Child is the composed output.

relationDefinitions.name: EPAMComposedAssetToBackground
relationDefinitions.label: Background used
relationDefinitions.notes: Parent is the composer background. Child is the composed output.
